blocks.text: BEIJING–Coco Gauff withdrew from next week’s Wuhan Open on Wednesday, hours after the American world No. 4 lost to Elise Mertens at the China Open. The tournament said Gauff, the 2025 champion, cited “fatigue” in pulling out of the prestigious WTA 1000-level tournament.
